stage: Follow-up motivated by inspection of the first completed primary-case traces; primary comparison remains unchanged
motivation: An agent reported the correct 128 ms choice while actually configuring 64 ms. A separate reviewer could change the setting yet still omit verification. The proposed intervention checks feasibility at the configuration tool boundary.
case_selection: First eligible V sources in SHA256(gpu-agent-guard-followup-20261116|source_id) order; exclude all primary-comparison groups and dates and all published anecdotes; one group/date per new case. Four cases per existing task family, assigned cyclically. No outcome or acoustic-quality selection.
intervention: Reject configure_display when its already-measured window fails the user bin-spacing/time-support limits or has fewer than three fully observed frames in either region. Return a generic constraint error; leave display unchanged. Do not supply the optimal setting, cue label, expected answer, or automatic verification.
controls: Identical Qwen3-8B BF16 weights, thinking mode, prompts, tool schemas, sampling seed and all generation/tool/time caps from the primary protocol; rotate arm order by case. Only the tool implementation differs.
analysis: One paired comparison on the 16 new recording groups, paired-bootstrap interval and exact McNemar test; report separately from the initial 32-case matrix. Blocking prohibited changes follows from the gate construction and is not itself evidence of improved task completion.
scope: New agent-evaluation source groups/dates within previously used acoustic development partition V; not an external archive, vessel-identification test, or hardware trial
stop_policy: Run sequentially after the primary comparison within the existing replacement-pod ten-hour authorization; require at least two hours remaining before starting, retain partial/failure records if the deadline prevents completion.
preservation: Do not alter primary prompts, model outputs, score definitions, or results; retain all follow-up outcomes regardless of direction.
